profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results-oriented software engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering cloud-native, performance-optimized backend systems in the financial services industry. 

Proven ability to design and implement micro service applications using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, messaging systems (RabbitMQ), and caching (Redis). 

Experienced in both greenfield development and R&D innovation, with contributions ranging from high-traffic production systems to experimental POCs to company executives. 

Currently on Platform team that powers both Traditional ML + GenAI use cases

positions.description:

positions.title: Market Research Intern and Translator
positions.description:
• Worked under the Senior Manager of Marketing for a fast-growing, market-leading web development and consulting agency
• Independently delivered 40 minute presentation assessing trends and corporate best practices of social media communication as final project
• Facilitated contractual presentations to Lotte Hotel evaluating deficiencies of its online marketing strategy
• Translated documents from Korean to English daily
• Created Excel Spreadsheet Reports on international market trends within the automobile industry

positions.title: Towle-Cunningham Hall Representative/Liaison
positions.description:
• Directly Represented and Advocated for 460 students (two UC halls) by voicing resident concerns while attending and participating in weekly debates to best improve student life experience in the dorms
• Planned and Executed four campus-wide Community Building Events with budgets up to $38,000
• Determined distribution of $139,000 annual RHA budget: Judging funding requests of programs hosted by various student organizations for their legitimacy and advocating to deny, grant, reduce, or increase requested amount based on their impact on and accessibility to residents
• Served as Member on Committee of Internal Affairs: Writing and revising assembly bills, updating governing documents, and communicating with the ASUC to collaborate on legislation
• Delivered weekly RHA reports to Towle-Cunningham Hall Association during individual Hall Association meetings
• Planned monthly events for Towle and Cunningham Residents in weekly Hall Association meetings outside RHA meetings
*RHA: the umbrella student government that represents each resident of the UC dorm system and supports all 15 Hall Associations Campus-wide*

positions.title: President of pledge class
positions.description:
•	Oversaw class projects to guarantee execution of final deliverable
•	Coordinated all class meetings to ensure class met all goals and deadlines
•	Served as Primary Liaison between the Chapter, Executives, and Prospective Members

projects.title: CS 170: DEVISE AN EFFICIENT ALGORITHM COMPETITION
projects.description: • Ranked Top 25% by creating a hybrid data structure and applying a self-created greedy approximation algorithm

projects.title: GITLET
projects.description:
-Implemented a version-control system that provides the same basic functionalities as Git (i.e. backing up directories of files through commits, restoring backups, viewing history of backups, maintaining related sequences of commits, merging changes made in one branch to another) using a series of HashMaps and HashSets
-Implemented serialization / deserialization of objects in Java by using SHAH-1 Hash Values
